system.description:
3rd Level Clan Feature

The Shikigami embodies a shinobi who specializes in preparation. Every move is calculated, and every fold has a purpose. You translate this into combat by constantly designing, and building origami one-fold at a time. At the beginning of each of your turns, or the first time each turn you cast a Shikigami Hijutsu, you summon a floating Origami called a Rei. These Rei can take any shape or design of your choice. They are charged with your chakra, and once per turn, can be spent on any of the following abilities. You can maintain up to 4 Rei at any given time, and can only generate them while in combat, or as an Action while out of combat. Effects that require a saving throw use your highest jutsu save DC. Spending two or more Rei, grants you the previous benefits as well as the upgraded benefits.

Origami Turtle. When a hostile creature deals damage to an allied creature within 30 feet of you, you can spend 1 Rei to interpose the Rei, and generate a chakra barrier with 1d10 + half your level hit points. Beginning at 7th level, by spending 2 Rei increase the barriers hit points by +1d10. Beginning at 15th level, by spending 3 Rei increase the barriers hit points by +1d10.

Origami Snake. As a Bonus action on your turn, you can spend 1 Rei to fling a coiling origami snake inscribed with a sealing formula at a creature you can see within 30 feet of you, forcing them to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, the snake wraps around them, reducing their speed by half, and they cannot move further than 30 feet away from you until the end of their next turn. They can spend their Action on their turn, to tear the snake, ending this effect immediately. Beginning at 7th level, by spending 2 Rei they are also pulled Prone. Beginning at 15th level, by spending 3 Rei they also have their speed reduced to 0.

Origami Bird. As a bonus action on your turn, you spend 1 Rei to place a small origami bird onto a creature you can see within 60 feet of you. This even occurs secretly unless the target creature has Chakra Sight or Chakra Sense. A creature remains marked in this way for 10 minutes and you always know this creatures location, regardless of concealment, invisibility, walls or barriers. A creature that spends 1 Action to perform the Search action can find the bird, destroying it. Beginning at 7th level, by spending 2 Rei A creature marked in this way cannot make attacks at advantage against you. Beginning at 15th level, by spending 3 Rei so long as they are within 120 feet of you, Shikigami Hijutsu or features with a range of at least 5 feet and doesn’t affect an area, can reach the marked creature.

Origami Rabbit. When a construct is summoned or commanded to act or move by a hostile creature, you can spend your Reaction and 1 Rei to disrupt its command, forcing the controlling creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the creature wastes their action commanding it. Beginning at 7th level, the creature follows your one command in place of their summoners until the end of the current turn. Beginning at 15th level, you can command them on your own turn, until the end of your turn.
